override_evm_target.reason: The Yul 'difficulty' built-in is gated by EVM target only, so on a pre-Paris target it must stay available on every language version.

expected_solc_divergence.reason: From '0.8.37' solc deprecates every EVM version older than London and warns about it, which is about the pinned Istanbul target rather than `difficulty`. Slang has no such deprecation, so it stays silent. Neither side rejects the input, which is what this test asserts.
